propositions: On bug close, auto-derive a caused_by link to a culprit commit via git blame if a strict majority (>50%) of blamed lines across file_impact point to a single commit that resolves to a ticket via rebar-ticket: trailer.
The --caused-by <id> parameter allows explicit override or augmentation of auto-derived caused_by links at close time.
The auto-link must bypass the closed-source guard by writing directly via _write_link_event after the bug transitions to closed status, since add_dependency rejects links from closed sources.

Blame resolution fails gracefully (returns None, does not block close) when no file_impact exists, no fixing commit is found, no dominant commit is identified, or the blamed commit lacks a resolvable rebar-ticket: trailer.
The library facade transition() in _lib_writes.py must accept and thread the caused_by parameter to enable library callers to set caused_by on close, not only CLI callers.
User documentation must include a blame-hunt advisory explaining when auto-derivation applies and when to use --caused-by explicitly.
